typesense:explore.greeting:
*The room is sparse. Rectangular. No art on the walls.*

*There is a desk. On the desk is a typewriter. Three unused pencils in parallel formation. A small German phrasebook. Orderly.*

*There is a bed. The linens are clean, with a pleasing graphical pattern. There are two pillows laid out exactly beside each other.*

*There is a door to your right leading to the living room.*

*There is a drawer. It's open. It contains socks and underwear.*

*Outside the window the weather is calm. Faint bird song is heard.*

*You look down.*

*There is a single sock with a polka-dot pattern lying in front of you.*
typesense:explore.name: Order, Please
typesense:explore.title: The room is orderly. There is a single sock on the floor.

title_i18n.ru: Комната в порядке. На полу лежит одна носка.
